references.name: unifin
references.review: Reviewed large left-aligned headline above broad photograph; rejected as too close to another hero for a mid-page About.

references.name: gauchere
references.review: Reviewed oversized condensed typography and staggered images; rejected because it relies on fashion imagery and typography outside Smartway tone.

references.name: advisor
references.review: Reviewed personal finance adviser hero; rejected portrait-on-right split as too close to the existing section structure.

references.name: zenith
references.review: Reviewed mobile story / team / values sequence; useful responsive precedent, but not selected for composition.

references.name: untitled
references.review: Reviewed generous header with horizontal portrait sequence; rejected because Smartway has one original team composite, not a gallery of named staff.

references.name: apriority
references.review: Search result could not resolve to requested work; generic fallback page. Not counted as reviewed relevant reference.

references.name: texpion
references.review: Selected primary. White About module has a 35/65 offset headline then copy left and large image right, separated by hairlines.

references.name: finser
references.review: Reviewed pastel feature-card composition; rejected gradients and app-oriented card grid.

references.name: fundex
references.review: Reviewed payment app showcase; rejected because phone UI and product data are not Smartway assets.

references.name: texpion-live-home-v1
references.review: Opened live page and visually inspected revealed section.about-us at full size. Confirmed headline/copy/image proportions and hairline divisions. Primary live composition source.
